title: multiple occupancy
content: had more luck with my recall today so here goes.. woke up because I think MW couldn't be bothered carrying on the charade. I'd just decided to stop fighting an 8ft 50s Michelin man style robot with my samurai sword because it was getting me nowhere. until that point I totally believed (remembering previous dreams within a dream) the aliens being here for real nullifies everything. this one started with a party, all very civilised (we live in communal housing in/above the mall. when we're not outside/elsewhere.) someone pointed out a pale face at the window. it was a dull orb (brown/grey) about head sized. I looked through the blinds and saw these 🛸 Roswell saucers (8/12ft) with lights round the rim. one sat motionless just above the trees. guess.. no more than 150ft from the ground. They also appeared to be together, while other saucers flew around to who knows where at a similar height. then above them again were huge carrier size NHI Ucraft, fighters and rescue, military, orbs, V's, Triangles, Jets, Drones etc. really going for it but I have no memory of any debris or destruction to things at ground level. ( I have previously though..) as a group we snapped to it and agreed to meet later, up around the town Square area. I wanted to get into the fight and an exhausted (apologetic) woman replied that the uniforms were in short supply but she'd see what she can do. I got a pair of designer black jeans?, a short pistol and a half dozen boxes of cartridges, various armbands?? and then presented with a box filled with headwear, US, British, Russian, NASDP, Japanese etc. etc.??? so I grabbed an assortment, put them in my bag and went down to the Mall for more supplies. the pharmacy was in the process of locking everything away but I took all the painkillers they had left (for unlucky casualties (and my hip)) when we got back to the square or not long after ranks of military dressed in black, headed by a fit and healthy JB started rounding people up for the fight. I joined along and walked with them for a while until I had an opportunity to escape, which I did, and that's when I was confronted by Robonator and MW just fizzled out. JB and the Snubnose are puzzling me though. we have neither in England.
